inputValue.label: Frontend Developer
inputValue.summary: Skilled Frontend Developer with a strong foundation in AngularJS and modern web technologies. Experienced in building responsive, high-performance web applications, optimizing UI/UX, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Proficient in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, and RESTful APIs, with a focus on delivering intuitive user experiences. Committed to staying updated with emerging frontend technologies and best practices.

tags: Developed high-performance, responsive web applications using React.js and TypeScript, achieving a 30% improvement in load times.
Integrated RESTful APIs and GraphQL with frontend systems for seamless data flow and real-time updates.
Enhanced application performance through code splitting and lazy loading, improving Lighthouse scores by 10+ points.
Conducted unit and end-to-end testing using Jest and Cypress, increasing code reliability and reducing production bugs by 25%.
Built and scaled high-conversion e-commerce platforms using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, and the Redux toolkit.
Developed custom checkout flows with fraud detection (PayStack integrations), reducing payment failures by 35%.
Optimized product search and recommendations using Elasticsearch, increasing average order value by 22%.
Implemented microservices architecture (Docker, Kubernetes) to support up to 10k+ users.
